semiconductor_relevance: High — Micro-Epsilon Japan specializes in precision measurement and inspection equipment critical for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Micro-Epsilon Japan is a leading manufacturer of advanced measurement instruments, focusing on high-quality sensors for the semiconductor industry. Their product offerings include capacitive sensors, chromatic confocal sensors, and white light interferometers, which are essential for wafer thickness measurement and inspection.
capabilities: Chromatic confocal sensors for surface topology measurement
White light interferometers for wafer thickness measurement
ReflecttCONTROL sensor system for 3D wafer strain measurement

regional_presence.Japan: The company has a strong presence in Japan, contributing to local manufacturing with high-quality measurement products.
